abstract:
PURPOSE: Colorectal cancer and pancreatic cancer represent some of the most aggressive forms of cancer. Curcumin (CUR) and Metformin (MET) have distinct pharmacokinetic profiles. MET is water-soluble, whereas CUR is highly lipophilic. These differences in their kinetic behavior may limit their synchronized therapeutic activity when used in combination. This study aimed to develop and characterize dual-loaded curcumin-MET niosomes (NIO-CUR-MET) and evaluate their physicochemical properties, drug release behavior, and in vitro anticancer, apoptotic, and anti-inflammatory effects against HCT-116 (colorectal) and PANC-1 (pancreatic) cancer cell lines.
METHODS: Niosomes were prepared using the ethanol injection method and characterized using dynamic light scattering. Drug loading efficiency was determined by HPLC. Drug release was assessed over 72 hours using a dialysis method at 37°C. Anticancer activity was evaluated using the MTT assay, apoptosis via Caspase-3/7 analysis, and anti-inflammatory effects by measuring TNF-α and IL-1β levels using ELISA.
RESULTS: The particle size of 152.7±54 nm, and zeta potential of -12±1.3 mV, indicating a stable and uniform nanosystem. Encapsulation efficiencies were achieved for MET (91.5%±5%) and CUR (39.8%±7%). Release was observed ~95% for CURand ~92% for MET over 72 hours. The NIO-CUR-MET formulation significantly enhanced cytotoxicity compared to free and single-drug forms, with lower IC₅₀ values in HCT-116 (4±3.2 µM for CUR and 190±10.2 µM for MET) and PANC-1 cells IC₅₀ values (5.2±0.9 µM for CUR and 202.5±8.2 µM for MET). It also induced a 5.3-fold increase in apoptosis (P<0.001).
CONCLUSION: Dual-loaded niosomes improved drug delivery performance and exhibited enhanced therapeutic efficacy against target cancer cell lines.

72시간 동안 약물 방출률은 curcumin(커큐민) 약 95%, metformin(메트포르민) 약 92%로 관찰되었습니다.
PANC-1 췌장암 세포주에서 IC₅₀ 값은 curcumin(커큐민) 5.2±0.9 µM, metformin(메트포르민) 202.5±8.2 µM이었습니다.
summary_ko: 이 연구는 물에 잘 녹는 metformin(메트포르민)과 지용성인 curcumin(커큐민)을 함께 전달하기 위해 이중 탑재 니오솜(NIO-CUR-MET)을 개발하고 그 특성을 평가했습니다. 연구진은 에탄올 주입법을 사용하여 니오솜을 제조하고 입자 크기, 약물 방출 거동, 췌장암 세포주(PANC-1)를 포함한 암세포에 대한 항암 및 세포사멸 효과를 측정했습니다. 실험 결과, NIO-CUR-MET 제형은 단일 약물 형태에 비해 세포독성과 세포사멸 효과를 유의하게 향상시켰습니다. 초록에 명시되지 않은 임상 환자 대상의 생존기간이나 반응률은 없습니다.
title: Dual-Loaded Curcumin-Metformin Niosomes: Physicochemical Characterization and In Vitro Activity in Colorectal and Pancreatic Cancer Cells
title_ko: 커큐민과 메트포르민을 동시에 탑재한 니오솜의 물리화학적 특성 및 대장암·췌장암 세포주에서의 체외 활성
